node.title: Re: podbrowser installation on linux
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Just as a note, I downloaded the .deb file for 16.04 from [https://packages.ubuntu.com/xenial/all/podbrowser/download|here] and it installed and appears to run fine on 18.04. All I had to do was apt install ./podbrowser_0.12-2_all.deb.
